caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a harp, positioned vertically on a plain, off-white background. The harp is rendered in shades of brown, with darker lines used to define the edges and wood grain texture. The soundbox, column, and neck of the harp display a wooden appearance with visible bands around the body, indicating structural elements. The neck curves at the top and features a scroll-like ornament with rows of small dots or studs decorating its length. Several thin, grayish strings extend from the neck to the soundbox. There are scattered vertical marks in rusty orange or brown primarily to the left of the harp and extending both above and below it. There is a small handwritten signature in the lower right corner reading "Grace Thomas Santa Fe," and the words "Plate 1" are written in cursive script at the center near the bottom edge of the image.
title: Stringed Harp
